semiconductor_relevance: High — Leeno Industrial Inc. specializes in semiconductor test probes and sockets, which are critical for ensuring the quality and reliability of semiconductor devices.
summary: Leeno Industrial Inc. is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor test probes and sockets, providing over 20,000 high-quality products designed to enhance testing efficiency and yield. Founded in 1978 in Busan, Korea, the company emphasizes customized solutions and rapid production capabilities to meet diverse testing needs.

regional_presence.Korea: Leeno Industrial Inc. was founded in Busan, Korea, and has established itself as a significant player in the semiconductor testing market.
